name: Hikkakareta Brawl Stars
original_name: 引っ掛かれた荒野乱斗
source:
Six children were locked in a white, closed room. All of them were confused by this abnormal situation when a human Rui, who calls himself "Master", suddenly announced to them:

"Shall the game, withdrawal from which will result in death, begin."
translation:
六个孩子被锁在一间白色的封闭房间里。所有人都被这反常的情况弄糊涂了，就在这时，一个自称“主人”的人类瑞突然向他们宣布：

“退出就会导致死亡的游戏开始吧。”
